policy: Each deletion requires an individually verified decision for the exact Git blob. Run --inspect, inspect dynamic entry points and persisted state, document test proof and rollback, then commit the change with the deletion.

evidence.purposeAndReason: Remove deferred logging-only test before cleaning out its deferred CLI dependency. This code was introduced only on cleanup/category-pass-20261017, after the user established that logging work must occur only after repository cleanup closes. Its removal is deliberate scope correction, not retirement of production telemetry.
evidence.realImportersAndConsumers: Known static consumers: none. The standalone CLI is not listed in package.json scripts or the CI workflow, and no production entrypoint imports it. Remove its companion test before removing the CLI; check manual operators separately.
evidence.dynamicRuntimeAndExternalCallers: The CLI is a manual opt-in command not dynamically loaded by production Next.js routes, and no scheduler or CI task invokes it. External copies or personal ad-hoc invocations cannot be exhaustively ruled out, but the CLI was added only in this temporary cleanup branch and has not been merged.
evidence.schemaDataAndHistoricalCompatibility: No Prisma model, SQL migration, serialized checkpoint contract, article record, evidence ledger or published URL depends on this newly introduced script. Existing production writer-trace-v1.ts implementation is intentionally retained and unmodified.
evidence.testEvidenceAndLiveRisks: The removal is limited to the new CLI and its dedicated test; check TypeScript, all Vitest tests, production build, and deletion gate on the final head. The CI result must be confirmed after changes; no claim of successful validation or live model testing is made.
evidence.rollbackPlan: Restore this exact blob e36b6e8d23ca871fad6186a6db492ce9ade6855e with git show from the parent before deletion, or revert the precise removal commit; independently, the initial script addition remains in Git history for a later, intentionally scoped logging phase.
